thread:
deploy-bot: Starting regional rollout v2.14.0 slice=regional-sequence window=2h regions=[us,eu,apac] canary=5%

sam: Kicking off US canary now. running smoke tests against /health and /generate.

anya: @sam good call — will watch latency dashboards (per-token and tail). let me know if p99 > 600ms for >3m.

lee: US capacity check: GPU pool util at 62%, queue length normal. should handle 5% canary + burst.

deploy-bot: US canary deployed: v2.14.0 -> instances: gateway-us-02, inference-us-04. events: canary-start

jun: quick note: pinned model variant is gptx-7b-quant-opt in the release config. fallback path ready: gptx-7b-fp16.

sam: smoke pass in US. basic generation and embeddings look sane. no obvious regression in tokens-per-second. :thumbsup:

anya: metrics: US error-rate steady at 0.3%, p95 240ms, p99 510ms. under thresholds. advancing EU canary in ~5m.

deploy-bot: Scheduling EU canary start at +8m. preflight checks: config diff ok, routing policy set to region=eu.

lee: EU pool report: reserved capacity currently 85% used due to batch jobs. we have ~2 free nodes for canary; ops approval needed for reserve bump.

ops-oncall: @lee we can burst an extra node from reserved pool for 30m. cost OK. grant approved. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: EU canary deployed: v2.14.0 -> instances: inference-eu-01 (canary). monitoring hooks active.

miguel: Observing EU p95 spiking to 680ms after ramp, p99 at 1.1s for a 3-minute window. error retries up from 0.4% -> 1.2%.

anya: Noted. that's above our soft threshold (p99 > 1s). hold EU progression. roll decision: pin EU traffic back to v2.13 for all non-critical routes and keep canary paused.

sam: Agreed. execute rollback for EU non-critical routes and keep canary for further triage.

deploy-bot: Rolling back EU non-critical routes to v2.13. Commands executed: kubectl -n redwood rollout undo deployment/inference-eu --to-revision=stable-v2.13

jun: We'll collect KV cache mismatch logs and the kernel selection traces for the canary instance. attaching quick grep snippet to pull logs:
```
# fetch last 10m logs for canary
rg "kernel_select|kv_cache_miss|latency_ms" /var/log/inference-eu-01/*.log | tail -n 200
```

miguel: Starting log pull now, sending raw bundle to s3://redwood-ci/rollbacks/1867771234-eu-debug.tar.gz

anya: EU rollback complete for non-critical; routing metrics indicate p99 back down to 360ms. thanks team.

lee: Summary: US progressed to staged rollout (20% traffic), EU pinned to v2.13 for steady-state, APAC pending capacity backfill.

deploy-bot: APAC scheduled next window in +45m. preflight warns: apac-gpu-pool at 76% and nightly backfill job queued at 02:00 UTC which will free nodes in ~3h.

ops-oncall: For APAC we can delay to the next change window (in ~3h) or proceed with a limited 2-node canary. recommendation: delay to avoid daytime capacity pinch in APAC.

sam: I second delay. we don't want to risk user-facing regressions in APAC prime hours. schedule new rollout for +3h30m and set canary to 2% then ramp.

anya: I'll open a short release note in the console: "v2.14.0: US staged rollouts progressing; EU pinned after latency regression on canary; APAC delayed to next window. Investigations ongoing (logs collected)."

deploy-bot: Rollout state updated: {us: staged-20%, eu: pinned-v2.13, apac: delayed}. Next action owners: @anya (investigate), @jun (logs & kernel traces), @ops-oncall (APAC scheduling).

miguel: I'll follow up with a short postmortem thread if logs point to kernel fallback issue. tagging folks who touched quantization paths.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll coordinate the APAC window and post confirmation in ~2h.

sam: Thanks everyone. if we see >0.8% error-rate on any canary for >5m, auto-rollback rule stands.

anya: noted. adding a short eval harness to run our fail-case prompts against the paused EU canary to reproduce.

deploy-bot: Canary guardrails: auto-rollback-if error_rate > 0.8% for 5m OR p99 > 1s for 3m. Rules active.

sam: good. closing thread for now. followups in #eng-incidents if anything spikes. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
